blocking_item: round 21 showed the registered rule identity was only proven on a sealed log; the recorded online pipeline run_a1_step2_gate can no longer be imported because scenario_saa.py dropped SoftKNNHistoricalSampler and the anytime_vote path, so the rule had not been shown deployable in a current-source online pipeline with a contemporaneous control
purpose: Qualify the registered deployment rule in a frozen current-source online pipeline together with a contemporaneous control arm under identical sampler, seed, K, time limit and contract, on the five already-consumed days. This is engineering: it produces no fresh utility day and starts no science.

arms.rule: registered deployment rule in front of the unmodified SaaReplanner
arms.control: the unmodified SaaReplanner alone (identical sampler/seed/K/time limit)

pipeline_semantics.entry: pipeline.run_arm in this directory (current sources only; the old pipeline is never edited)
pipeline_semantics.online_loop: StrictOnlineEnv.run per day, per-reveal decision, K=10 SAA scenarios, per-request time limit
pipeline_semantics.timing: per-day request seconds are recorded and compared with the registered 10 s time limit
pipeline_semantics.control_logging: the control arm is not instrumented per order; its behaviour is compared at day-row level

identity_chain: rule artifacts are read read-only from the v3 stage and both of its hashes are verified before use, so this stage cannot silently fork the rule

gates.rule_reproduces_v4_candidate: per-day utility equality against the v4 candidate rows
gates.control_reproduces_v4_control: per-day utility equality against the v4 control rows; if the scenario_saa drift changed control behaviour this must fail and the five-day comparison is invalidated under current sources
gates.paired_delta_matches_v4: the paired difference must equal the v4 paired difference
gates.hard_feasible_and_within_budget: every arm-day must be hard feasible and inside the budget
gates.within_time_limit: every arm-day request must be inside the registered time limit

failure_criteria: rule or control row differs from the v4 rows
paired difference differs from the v4 paired difference
any arm-day not hard feasible, over budget, or over the time limit
any registered source or identity hash mismatch
stop_rule: on any failure the stage stops at engineering and reports that the five-day comparison is not deployable under current sources
preserves: the v3 result and the recorded source-drift evidence, untouched
all old FAIL artifacts; nothing is re-run to chase a PASS
